problem.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; Chinese explanation independently paraphrased
facts: Maximum depth is the number of nodes along the longest root-to-leaf path.
The number of nodes is in [0,10^4].

claims.claim: Each node is visited once, giving O(n) time; DFS auxiliary stack is O(h), where h is tree height.
An iterative DFS implementation avoids relying on Python's recursion limit for a highly skewed tree.
claims.validation: Implementation uses an explicit stack of (node,depth) pairs.
